solves.reason: (A) personal: 'personal relations' 본문 핵심. (B) essential: 'seen as essential'. (C) oral: 'oral relationships rather than written'.
(A) traveled: 'tutor who traveled to homes'. (B) considerable: 'played a considerable part'. (C) engagement: 'active engagement'.
(A) collecting: 'collecting teachers and students into learning communities'. (B) deep: 'a deep and absolutely personal bond'. (C) interpersonal: 'interpersonal oral relationships'.
③ trivial은 부적절. 원문은 'essential(필수적)'이라 여겨짐. trivial(사소한)은 정반대.
② obstacle은 부적절. 원문은 'approach(접근법)'. obstacle(장애물)은 정반대.
④ impersonal은 부적절. 원문은 'interpersonal(대인 간의)'. impersonal(비인격적인)은 정반대.
집으로 이동해 개인/소규모 학생을 가르치는 사람 = tutor(가정교사).
'supported the active ___ of students in learning' = engagement(참여).
'played a ___ part' = considerable(상당한). 감정의 역할 크기를 나타냄.
occurred(일어나다) = happened(일어나다). 동의어.
approach(접근법) = method(방법). 동의어.
supported(지지하다) = advocated(옹호하다). 동의어.
advanced(고급의) ↔ elementary(초보의). 반의어.
close(친밀한) ↔ distant(먼, 소원한). 반의어.
(A) played a considerable part = 역할(명사). (B) part with = 헤어지다(동사).
'close connection or tie between people, based on shared feelings' = bond(유대).
'its ___ organizations' 수식 자리. descend → descendent(후속의).
'was ___ seen as essential' 부사 자리. consist → consistently.
'another approach to creating ___' = a social learning context. 플라톤 아카데미 같은 학습 공동체.
'rather than ___' = through written materials. 구두 관계와 대비되는 수단.
